mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bt_dc_worksheet ( id, document_id, sheet_id, snapshot_id, name, row_count, column_count, index, block_id, original_meta, created_time, updated_time, status_cd ) VALUES ( #{entity.id}, #{entity.documentId}, #{entity.sheetId}, #{entity.snapshotId}, #{entity.name}, #{entity.rowCount}, #{entity.columnCount}, #{entity.index}, #{entity.blockId}, #{entity.originalMeta}, , , #{entity.statusCd} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, document_id, sheet_id, snapshot_id, name, row_count, column_count, sheet_index, block_id, original_meta, tenant_id, created_time, updated_time, status_cd FROM bt_dc_worksheet WHERE document_id = #{documentId} and snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND status_cd = '00A' ORDER BY sheet_index
